returning: detail: activated off injured reserve and available for the game
away.summary: The Flyers (5-10-5) are on a challenging road trip, having won their most recent game in Vancouver 3-1. Rasmus Ristolainen returns to the lineup after missing seven games with a hand injury, while Nikita Grebenkin remains out with a back issue.

home.summary: The Oilers (13-3-3) have won back-to-back games and have points in eight of their last 10. Colton Dach returns from illness, while Connor Murphy will play despite not practicing Tuesday. Goaltending remains a concern with Frederik Andersen out long-term.
